scripts.test:
echo '
Error: The root "npm test" command is intentionally disabled.

Instead, run specific test suites:
  - npm run test:trace:core
  - npm run test:appsec
  - etc.

Or run individual test files:
  npx mocha path/to/test.spec.js

See CONTRIBUTING.md (Testing section) for more details.
' && exit 1
scripts.prepare: node scripts/patch-istanbul-lib-coverage.js && node scripts/patch-v8-to-istanbul.js && cd vendor && npm ci --include=dev
scripts.lint:fix: node scripts/check_licenses.js && node scripts/check-agents-md-size.js && node scripts/check-no-coverage-artifacts.js && node scripts/check-no-mcr-images.js && node scripts/check-docker-image-shas.js && eslint . --concurrency=auto --max-warnings 0 --fix
scripts.lint:editorconfig: docker build -q -t ec .github/editorconfig-checker && docker run --rm --volume=$PWD:/check ec
